Interface Grammar:
- /domains/interface-grammar/README.md

Product repositories are authoritative for shipped implementation.
Foundry is authoritative for governed cross-project knowledge, but Canonical is maturity rather than timeless truth.
Use computed effective authority; quarantined knowledge is not default guidance.
Evidence lineage, scope, assumptions, freshness, and directness are first-class.
A single observation must not be promoted directly to Canonical.
Interactive agent sessions are disposable workers; durable repository state is the recovery source of truth.
\n
